L12: ## About Me
L13: 
L14: I am Mohammad Reza Mahdiani, a Software Architect at DataRobot, PhD, building production-grade AI/ML platforms and scalable systems for enterprise-scale problems. I bring years of hands-on industry experience turning complex technical challenges into shippable, reliable products — and leading the engineering teams that build them.
L15: I'm the author of Mastering Machine Learning Architecture and Solutions (Apress/Springer), a practitioner's guide to designing and deploying ML systems in production, and my technical work is referenced over 770 times across the industry and research community. My focus is on cross-functional leadership, mentoring engineers, and delivering cutting-edge, future-ready solutions at scale.

L30: Spearheaded the creation of an intelligent workflow optimization system leveraging natural language processing (NLP) and cutting-edge large language models (LLMs). L34: ### Personalized Content Recommendation Engine
